cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last cup before your taxi comes. I taught you to dry the handle too, remember?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Much better than last time. Could you put it on the shelf? Finishing means putting away; we covered that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. The driver's calling. I've got to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Answer him here a moment. You still rush your thank-yous. What's his name? Let me hear you thank him properly for waiting.
